description: This file defines the Review class in the Opencart e-commerce framework, specifically handling the email notification process when a product review is submitted. It loads relevant product information and sends email alerts to configured recipients.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Handles the email notification process triggered after a product review is added.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method called to process review email notifications, loads product data, prepares email content, and enqueues email sending tasks.
